corrections.originalValue: Strongest feature: The challenge exposes a genuine methodological danger: evidence cannot acquire proximity merely by being measured against a biographical timeline whose historical status is itself under dispute, so the benchmark requires independent justification rather than silent adoption. Principal limitation: The assertion that there is no way to determine what counts as early is materially overbroad, because documents and traditions can be dated by independent textual, historical, and manuscript criteria even if their distance from a particular life remains contested. Live burden: The con side must separate independent document dating from the disputed event chronology and explain why the former cannot still constrain plausible origin models. Locked score: The mixed band reflects a perceptive circularity diagnosis and direct burden contact, offset by exaggerated necessity language, incomplete accommodation of independent dating, and a conclusion broader than the objection establishes.

corrections.originalValue: Strongest feature: The Superman and Clark Kent analogy sharply redirects attention from bare compatibility to explanatory adequacy, asking why a mundane residue would be remembered, transmitted, or causally capable of producing traditions dominated by an exalted, miracle-working figure. Principal limitation: The analogy partly slides among three different propositions—whether a person existed, whether mundane events were preserved, and whether that person adequately explains Christianity—while a fictional superhero comparison cannot establish that every demythologized tradition lacks a historical core. Live burden: The con side must specify which recoverable claims fail and show why staged legendary development from an ordinary founder is comparatively implausible. Locked score: The strong band recognizes an incisive and responsive explanatory challenge, tempered by category slippage, limited evidentiary support, and insufficient engagement with the narrower claim that legend and existence remain logically compatible.
